purpose: Optional local semantic candidates for low-lexical-overlap evidence; no replacement of the default lexical route and no generalization guarantee.

model.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling, then L2 normalization

index.source: current page content only; no benchmark queries, labels, or generated summaries
index.windows: tokenizer-offset windows covering the complete page, at most 128 model tokens including special tokens
index.build: explicit command; encode a source snapshot outside the write transaction, publish only if its revision is still current
index.freshness: database revision and model fingerprint must both match; stale or missing indexes raise a clear rebuild error
index.persistence: derived vectors in separate SQLite tables; source rows, page IDs and source offsets are preserved

retrieval.scope: apply project/chapter/session filters before ranking or candidate limits
retrieval.similarity: maximum cosine similarity across each page's windows and the query's windows
retrieval.fusion: equal-weight reciprocal rank fusion with k=60 over lexical and semantic page ranks

evaluation.existing_public_and_synthetic_cases: regression data, including the earlier six-domain diagnostic
evaluation.new_independent_corpus: must be separately frozen before scoring; disclose model pretraining overlap as unknown
report: index build time and vector bytes
evaluation.guard: no parameter selection or question-specific synonym lists using held-out labels; a failed or slower candidate remains a reported result
evaluation.limits: Sentence embeddings do not establish final-answer quality, full competitor-workflow cost advantage, or general semantic-memory completion.
